Information related to: * A function's eligibility for 1st Gen to 2nd Gen migration. * Current state of
migration for function undergoing migration.
{
"severity": enum (Severity (/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#Severity)),
"type": string,
"message": string
}
JSON representation
Fields
upgradeState
enum (UpgradeState
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#UpgradeState))
UpgradeState of the function
serviceConfig
object (ServiceConfig
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#ServiceConfig))
Describes the Cloud Run service which has been setup to prepare for 2nd gen
upgrade.
eventTrigger
object (EventTrigger
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#EventTrigger))
Describes the Event trigger which has been setup to prepare for 2nd gen upgrade.
buildConfig
object (BuildConfig
(/functions/docs/reference/rest/v2/projects.locations.functions#BuildConfig))
Describes the Build step of the function that builds a container to prepare for 2nd gen
upgrade.
